Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 23 October 2026 23 October 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 11 August 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. Date of purchase: Number of Ordinary Shares purchased: Average price paid per Share (pence): Lowest price paid per Share (pence): Highest price paid per Share (pence): 19-Oct-2026 243,080 274.8589 273.2000 276.6000 20-Oct-2026 255,234 275.0813 272.2000 276.4000 21-Oct-2026 251,127 276.7872 274.0000 278.4000 22-Oct-2026 280,000 275.4578 273.8000 278.2000 23-Oct-2026 255,345 276.4602 271.8000 280.2000 Following the above transactions, the Company will have 959,199,868 Ordinary Shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 43,546,146 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 23 October 2026 is 959,199,868 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 11 August 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 15,095,681 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
